title: Crusader Wars 2 options
description: The one ledger: every CW2 option lives here and only here. Canon: docs tw3k frontend ui/Canon_ Crusader Wars 2 - UI_Mapping Architecture.pdf (schemas/config.schema.json). The launcher discovers config/cw2_config.json by walking up from the exe and validates it against this file.

show_mode.description: Result/report density in the launcher: tactical shows the full per-unit table, minimal a one-line summary, dramatic the table plus a flavor line.

army_scale_factor.description: Multiplier applied to both sides' CK3 fighting men before staging; Three Kingdoms army caps still apply on top.

auto_battle_report.description: When on, the launcher polls the Three Kingdoms battle log on the Fight step and advances to the result by itself; when off, the player presses Get the result manually.

enable_tw3k_screenshots.description: Request screenshots of the Three Kingdoms battle into the run folder. Only the request seam exists today; no capture backend yet.

domain_focus.description: Faction focus for unit rolls: wei/shu/wu filter out other factions' unique units and favour their own (faction tags are a playtest draft); custom keeps the neutral pool.

injectivity_strict.description: Safety rail over config/slots.registry.json: when on, a CK3 character id or CW2 slot appearing twice aborts with an error; when off, violations are logged and the run continues.

cut_3d_voice.description: RESERVED - formally declared UNDEFINED (turn-2 section 4). Stored in the ledger for compatibility; no behavior may attach to this key.
